name: Ensure Code Quality
description: Always run `npm test` and `npx eslint .js` on all JavaScript code written. Use these tools as a quality gate — no JS changes should be committed without passing all tests and having zero lint errors.

skills.name: ensure-code-quality
skills.description: When writing or modifying JavaScript, always run `npm test` (Jest) and `npx eslint .js` to verify correctness and code quality. Report any failures or lint errors before proceeding.
